title: Personal Agent — Builder Skill Trigger
description: Declarative activation condition for a builder skill. A trigger says WHEN a skill fires and WHAT it produces, mapped onto a host hook (Claude Code hooks / OpenCrab crab_orchestration entry conditions / cron). The cardinal rule: a trigger fires DETECTION/STAGING only; promotion to a confirmed runtime-active record stays gated (requires_confirmation) unless an explicit auto_confirm_policy permits it for narrow high-confidence, non-sensitive cases. Spec: spec/09-triggers.md. Skills own their trigger; crab_orchestration aggregates them into a routing table.

trigger_id.description: Stable id, format pab.<skill>.<on_signal> e.g. pab.diff_mining.on_correction

signal.description: The observable event/condition that fires the trigger.

condition.description: Human-readable predicate refining the signal (e.g. 'agent output edited or rejected by user').

cadence.description: How often / on what rhythm the trigger evaluates.

host_hook.description: Where the trigger binds in the host runtime — a single hook token, OR a YAML list of tokens for a multi-hook binding (e.g. [UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse] when the same trigger binds ambient capture on both the prompt and the tool result; see skills/14-host-binding.md §2). Claude Code hook events, an OpenCrab crab_orchestration entry condition, cron, or a slash command. SessionStart=compile; UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse=ambient capture; PreToolUse=pre-action boundary; Stop=session-end mining + review board.

produces.description: The lifecycle stage output this trigger creates. NOTE: capture/mine/extract/scope/route produce STAGED artifacts (pending); only confirmation_gate produces a confirmed/runtime-active record (or auto_confirm_policy does, narrowly).

requires_confirmation.description: If true, the produced artifact cannot become a runtime-active record without explicit human review (Gate G3). Detection/staging triggers set false (they only stage pending items); the confirmation_gate and any boundary/decision-affecting promotion set true.

default_state.description: Privacy-conservative default. enabled=on out of the box; suggested=proposed to the user, off until accepted; off=opt-in only. Sensitive/high-stakes skills default to suggested or off.

stages_to.description: Optional pack visibility for staged output: 'draft' (OpenCrab draft pack) or 'pending' (in-session queue). Promotion changes this to the live instance pack only after the gate.

auto_confirm_policy.description: OPTIONAL narrow bypass of the confirmation gate. When ALL conditions hold, a staged candidate may be promoted without interactive review. Absent = always require human review (the safe default). The decision rule and how thresholds are set (regret = impact x (1-confidence); four axes; four-layer calibration) are formalized in spec/12-confirmation-policy.md.

min_confidence.description: Backward-compatible flat threshold used when impact_tier/per_tier_threshold are absent (e.g. 0.9). Superseded per-tier by per_tier_threshold when present.

allowed_sensitivity.description: Only these sensitivity classes may auto-confirm (never restricted; sensitive only with a boundary rule). HARD override regardless of regret (Gate G5).

require_any.description: At least one strong-evidence condition must hold.

never_auto_confirm_types.description: Candidate types that ALWAYS require human review regardless of confidence (e.g. BoundaryRuleCandidate, DecisionPolicyCandidate). Equivalent to impact_tier 'A' (always confirm).

impact_tier.description: Blast-radius grade of the candidate/target pack governing this trigger (spec/12 §2). A=always confirm (identity_roles/decision_policy/boundary_authority/red_flags; changes WHO the agent is or what it MAY do); B=auto only when mature+high-confidence (persona_core/tacit_heuristics/workflow_playbooks/domain_overlays/memory_project_graph); C=auto at high confidence (communication_style/artifact_policy/tool_stack). Tier A may never auto-confirm.

per_tier_threshold.description: Per-tier minimum confidence, refining the flat min_confidence (spec/12 §3 axis 2). A is set unreachable (>1) so Tier A always falls through to human review. Recommended default {A:1.01, B:0.95, C:0.90}.

A.description: Set >1 (e.g. 1.01) to make Tier A unreachable = always confirm.

maturity_gate.description: Minimum convergence maturity tier (spec/06) at which this policy may ACT rather than only stage (spec/12 §4.4). Autonomy is earned: Tier B auto-confirm typically unlocks at L2+, and only after shadow-mode calibration (target_error_rate) passes for that tier. Tier C is exempt from the maturity gate (low blast radius, instantly correctable). To avoid a self-reinforcing loop, the gating signal is measured on the HUMAN gate stream only (auto-confirmed promotions are excluded; use human_confirmation_ratio plus auto-confirm-independent metrics like decision_fidelity/correction_cost). Below this tier, candidates fall through to human review.

target_error_rate.description: Calibration target for shadow-mode validation (spec/12 §4.3). The policy first runs in shadow (PREDICT confirm/hold, NO-ACT) and its disagreement rate vs the human gate decision must stabilize at or below this value before it is allowed to act. e.g. 0.05 (<=5%). Grounded in Tesla shadow mode.

$comment: Trigger fires detection/staging only; promotion stays gated unless auto_confirm_policy narrowly permits it. This is how the system stays safe to leave 'always on' (Gates G3 no-pending-activation, G5 privacy-before-promotion). Host mapping: Claude Code hooks for in-session ambient capture + session-boundary review; Cron(durable) for batch processing of prior transcripts; OpenCrab ingest_text(pack_visibility='draft') as the staging store.
